BiblicalUsage: Sig is a withdrawal, a stepping aside into a private place, and it appears once, in Elijah's mockery on Carmel. Cry aloud, he tells the prophets of Baal, for he is a god: either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth. Perhaps your god has stepped aside.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elijah's mockery is theology with teeth, because a god who can be withdrawn, asleep, or on a journey is no god at all.
